home.heroEyebrow: The last piece of the puzzle
home.heroTitle: The last piece. / The complete picture.
home.heroSubtitle: Discover intelligent software solutions designed to simplify operations, connect systems and complete your business technology puzzle.
home.introTitle: One ecosystem. Every piece in place.
home.introBody: SCHLUSS brings retail systems, stock control, logistics, business management and IT together. Instead of juggling disconnected tools, you get software that is designed to fit – and a network of partners who install, support and maintain it.
home.conceptBody: Schluss is German for the end, the conclusion, the close. It is the moment the final piece clicks into place and the whole picture makes sense. That is what we build for your business.

why.title: Built to connect
why.body: Products share data and work together, so your systems stop living in silos.

why.title: Local support
why.body: Approved SCHLUSS partners install, train and maintain – close to where you operate.

why.title: Try before you commit
why.body: Free trials and live demonstrations, so you know it fits before you buy.

why.title: Always improving
why.body: Managed versions and clear release notes keep every installation current and secure.

home.supportBody: Every product comes with guides, videos and step-by-step instructions in the Learning Centre – and real people when you need them.
home.ctaTitle: Find the piece your business is missing
home.ctaBody: Explore the SCHLUSS product range or talk to us about what you need.

about.title: About SCHLUSS
about.intro: SCHLUSS is a South African technology company building software that brings business operations together.
body: We design and deliver software for retail, stock management, logistics, business administration and IT – products that work on their own and work even better together.
Our products reach customers through SCHLUSS directly and through approved business partners who sell, install and support them locally.
Our name says what we do: Schluss means the conclusion, the close – the last piece that completes the puzzle.

partners.title: Grow With SCHLUSS.
partners.subtitle: Become part of a connected technology ecosystem. Sell, implement and support software solutions that help businesses operate better.

benefits.title: A growing product range
benefits.body: Offer your customers a family of connected business products.

benefits.title: Training & sales material
benefits.body: Product training, installation manuals, presentations and marketing assets.

benefits.title: Your own partner portal
benefits.body: Manage your customers, installations, maintenance and licence renewals in one place.

benefits.title: Partner pricing
benefits.body: Partner discounts and commission on eligible products.

footer.tagline: Software, retail systems and IT – connected. The last piece of your business technology puzzle.
